what_it_pays_for: Viewers buy Stars and send them as gifts on your reels; the platform pays you USD 0.01 per Star received, monthly. It is a tipping mechanic rather than a subscription, and its bar is far lower than the subscription one.

revenue_basis.note: Unusually, the rate here is published rather than assumed. The number of Stars a creator receives is not, so a range still needs the creator's own volume.

additional_requirements_not_assessed: Must meet the Partner Monetization Policies and stay compliant with Community Standards and Content Monetization Policies.
Must accept the Instagram Gifts Creators Terms.
Must have set up a payout account, or gifts can be seen but not collected.
Collaborative posts, and accounts that primarily post content focused on children, cannot earn from Gifts.

provenance.source_title: How to earn money on Instagram Gifts
provenance.note: Read in full 2026-08-27. Supersedes this library's earlier draft, which modelled Gifts as invitation-only; the page states a 500-follower bar. The page also states the payout rate: USD 0.01 per Star received.

retrieval.note: The Instagram help centre renders client-side: a plain fetch returns the shell with no article body, so a re-check must drive a real browser.

requirements.note: Visible on the public profile, so this one does not have to be left to the creator to check.
The page reads 'Have at least 500 followers'.

合拍帖子、以及主要发布以儿童为主题内容的账号不能通过礼物赚钱。
